description: Toolchain version is detected by the operator-managed runner; no automatic installation in this release.
Runner agent uses Node.js 22 or newer. Host snapshot reports runtime version.
Planned support for version-pinned Node.js, pnpm/npm, Astro/Vite and similar static export builds on an available managed Linux, macOS or Windows builder; deployment is controller-owned.
Planned native static-site generator; potential Linux ARM64/x64, macOS, and Windows build-host profiles require version validation.
Planned Python/MkDocs site builds with pinned Python and package dependencies, hosted on compatible managed builders.
Planned destinations for verified, prebuilt static assets. Publishing permissions and provider credentials are controller-managed, not builder-managed.
